result.title: Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls
result.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Data, labels, and scripts: https://github.com/flame-stream/agent-recovery-harm
result.summary: Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. If a block fails after some of its writes have taken effect, the agent rewrites the block and continues. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. In a stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models, 145 are partial executions confirmed by the database state. In the sample, 30 of 143 confirmed partial executions with a determinable outcome are followed by a harmful recovery, and its violation remains at the end of the run, which gives a stratification-weighted estimate of 24.6%. Two thirds of the harmful recoveries duplicate an effect, and the rest delete user data or make a wrong first-time write, e.g., an order of a wrong product. A rule that searches for repeated calls finds 75% of duplications but only 41% of all harm. We also examine two sources of operation identity for an idempotency contract. In a small pilot (17 episodes, one local model), identifiers supplied by the model do not detectably reduce harm, because the model issues a new identifier for the same operation. Identity derived from the call content, evaluated counterfactually on the sample, would have matched every harmful write in 14 to 18 of the 30 harmful recoveries, but in none of those with a wrong first-time write, and it would also have matched writes required by the task in 30 episodes. Based on these results, we outline design requirements for safer agent recovery.

AI.brief_summary: 论文测量代码执行型 LLM agent 部分写入成功后重写代码继续执行所带来的危害：在 AppWorld 轨迹分层抽样中，加权估计 24.6% 的恢复有害，并比较模型自报标识与调用内容派生标识用于幂等契约的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但「由调用内容而非模型自报来判定同一操作」以及恢复/停止判据的检测缺口（重复调用规则仅覆盖 41% 危害），可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正绑定证据、以及诊断规则覆盖面提供类比线索。
